title: ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE FUNCTIONAL SERICULTURE INDUSTRY FOSTERAGE AND SUPPORT ACT
title_original: 기능성 양잠산업 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Functional Sericulture Industry Fosterage and Support Act and the Enforcement Decree of that Act, and matters necessary for their enforcement.

Article 2 (Detailed Designation Criteria for Specialized Personnel Training Institutions, etc.)
(1) "Application for designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs" in the main clause of Article 6(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Functional Sericulture Industry Fosterage and Support Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") means the application for designation as a specialized personnel training institution in attached Form 1.

(2) Upon receiving an application under Article 6(1) of the Decree for designation as a specialized personnel training institution under Article 9-3(2) of the Functional Sericulture Industry Fosterage and Support Act (hereinafter referred to as a "specialized personnel training institution"), the Administrator of the Rural Development Administration, a Special Metropolitan City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayor, Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Do Governor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, or the head of a Si, Gun, or Gu (the head of a Gu means the head of an autonomous Gu) shall verify a certificate of corporate registration (only for a corporation) or a certificate of business registration (meaning a certificate of business registration that excludes the resident registration number; hereinafter the same shall apply in this paragraph) through the sharing of administrative information under Article 36(1) of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to verification of the certificate of business registration, the applicant shall be required to attach that document.

(3) The detailed designation criteria for specialized personnel training institutions under Article 6(2) of the Decree are as specified in the attached Table.

(4) "Certificate of designation prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs" in Article 6(3) of the Decree means the certificate of designation as a specialized personnel training institution in attached Form 2.

Article 3 (Review of Regulations)
The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs shall review the appropriateness of the detailed designation criteria for specialized personnel training institutions under Article 2(3) and the attached Table every 3 years, measured from January 1, 2026 (meaning by the day before the corresponding reference date in each year in which 3 years have elapsed), and shall take measures such as improvements.

ADDENDA <Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs No. 732, August 22, 2025>
This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE FUNCTIONAL SERICULTURE INDUSTRY FOSTERAGE AND SUPPORT ACT [Attached Table]

Detailed Designation Criteria for Specialized Personnel Training Institutions (Related to Article 2(3))

1. Curriculum and Training Content

(a) The curriculum must comprise at least 50 hours in total and must include theory, practical training, and field learning.

(b) The training subjects must comprise the subjects in the following table. Depending on the characteristics of the curriculum, the hours for each subject may vary, and additional subjects related to the functional sericulture industry may be offered and operated.

| Training subject | Training content |
|---|---|
| 1) Understanding silkworms | (a) Silkworm morphology; (b) Silkworm life cycle; (c) Silkworm rearing environment and physiology; (d) Development and current designation status of superior silkworm varieties; (e) Production and distribution system for high-quality silkworm eggs |
| 2) Silkworm rearing | (a) Planning for silkworm rearing; (b) Hatching silkworm eggs and rearing young silkworms (silkworms newly hatched from eggs); (c) Techniques for rearing large silkworms (silkworms that have completed their third molt); (d) Standard sericulture technology systems that reduce labor requirements; (e) Production and quality control of silkworms for food and medicinal use; (f) Silkworm mounting [sangjok (上簇): placing silkworms that have completed their final molt and are ready to spin cocoons on mountages or mats] and cocoon harvesting [sugyeon (收繭): collecting the cocoons that silkworms have spun on mountages]; (g) Understanding silkworm diseases and methods of prevention |
| 3) Mulberry field management (for silkworm rearing and for mulberry fruit) | (a) Description and characteristics of mulberry varieties; (b) Establishment of mulberry fields and management of fertilization and cultivation (meaning applying fertilizer to and tending plants); (c) Control of diseases and pests in mulberry fields and disaster countermeasures; (d) Safe use of pesticides on mulberry trees (mulberry fruit) |
| 4) Industrialization of sericulture products | (a) Silkworm powder production technology and health-promoting effects; (b) Hongjam production technology and health-promoting effects [hongjam means cooked mature silkworms prepared by steaming and freeze-drying fully grown mature silkworms, or sukjam (熟蠶), whose bodies are filled with silk proteins]; (c) Male silkworm pupa production technology and health-promoting effects; (d) Cultivation technology for cordyceps grown on silkworms and its health-promoting properties; (e) Functional properties and utilization technology of silk proteins; (f) Functional properties and utilization technology of mulberry leaves; (g) Functional properties and utilization technology of mulberry fruit |
| 5) Field learning | (a) Practical training in silkworm rearing techniques; (b) Practical training in mulberry tree (mulberry fruit) cultivation techniques; (c) Sericulture product processing technology and the process of turning these products into commercial products; (d) Sixth-industry experiences, including silkworm and mulberry-fruit experience programs |

(c) A training plan for the training content and curriculum that conforms to (a) and (b) must have been established.

2. Training Facilities and Equipment

(a) Training facilities for operating the curriculum must be provided in a location suitable in terms of the educational environment and health and hygiene.

(b) All of the following training facilities and equipment must be provided. If the right to use such facilities and equipment is secured through a lease agreement or a joint-use agreement, and this fact is demonstrated by documents, the facilities and equipment shall be deemed to be provided during the term of that agreement.
1) Lecture rooms and practical training rooms: their size must be appropriate to the scale of the curriculum.
2) Toilets: they must be separated by sex and appropriate to the scale of the curriculum.
3) Teaching aids, equipment and materials for practical training, and other items necessary for operating the curriculum must be provided.
4) Facilities necessary for learners' convenience, such as meeting rooms and resource rooms, must be provided.

3. Specialized Instructors

(a) At least 1 specialized instructor must be secured.

(b) A specialized instructor must be a person who falls under any one of the following:
1) A person who has obtained a master's degree or higher in sericulture, entomology, or another field related to silkworms or functional sericulture;
2) A person with experience working at a university, research institute, or similar institution in sericulture, entomology, or another field related to silkworms or functional sericulture;
3) A public official, or an executive officer or employee of a public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, with work experience related to the sericulture industry or insect industry.

4. A plan for financing operating expenses must have been established.

Enactment Text

⊙ Ordinance of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs No. 732
The Enforcement Rule of the Functional Sericulture Industry Fosterage and Support Act is hereby promulgated as follows.

August 22, 2025
Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (seal)

ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE FUNCTIONAL SERICULTURE INDUSTRY FOSTERAGE AND SUPPORT ACT

[Omitted because it is identical to the main text]

ADDENDA
This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Grounds for Enactment and Amendment

[Enactment]

◇ Grounds for Enactment and Main Content
The Functional Sericulture Industry Fosterage and Support Act and its Enforcement Decree have been amended to allow the State and local governments, in order to train the specialized personnel needed to foster and support the functional sericulture industry, to designate universities under the Higher Education Act and research institutes, institutions, or organizations established for purposes such as research activities concerning the functional sericulture industry as specialized personnel training institutions and have them provide the necessary education and training. In line with these amendments, this Rule prescribes matters delegated by the Act and its Enforcement Decree and matters necessary for their enforcement. These include detailed criteria for designation as a specialized personnel training institution needed to foster and support the functional sericulture industry, such as a curriculum totaling at least 50 hours and including theory, practical training, and field learning; an established training plan for training content and a curriculum consistent with the training hours and subjects; at least 1 specialized instructor with qualifications such as a master's degree or higher in sericulture, entomology, or similar fields; and the provision of teaching aids, practical training equipment and materials, and other items necessary for operating the curriculum.

<Provided by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs>
